_note: THE EVENT PAYLOADS — what `on:stateChange`, `on:event`, `on:load` and `on:error` actually deliver. THE LAW. (1) `on:stateChange` is `{machine, state}` and fires on a TRANSITION, not on an advance: a state that survives sixty frames is one emission, and returning to a previous state emits again. A machine advancing at 60/s that reported every frame would be a handler storm, and an author would debounce it in markup, badly. (2) `on:event` is `{name, properties}`. Properties keep booleans, finite numbers and strings; anything else is DROPPED and counted, because a bus payload is data and a nested handle is not portable. Keys are emitted in sorted order so three renderers agree. (3) A RIVE openUrl EVENT IS DATA, NEVER A NAVIGATION. The .riv file is an asset, and an asset that could open a URL by itself would be a hole an OTA-delivered animation walks through: the fold delivers `{url, target}` as properties and the component navigates nothing. The author decides, in their own handler. (4) An unnamed event is dropped entirely. (5) `on:load` carries the resolved selection plus the artboard's INTRINSIC size, which is what a caller needs to size a box around it. (6) `on:error` is `{code, message}` over a closed code set; an unknown code keeps the code and takes the generic message rather than vanishing. Functions: riveStateChanges · riveEventPayload · riveLoadPayload · riveErrorPayload on all three.

stateChanges.name: the first observed state is emitted
a repeated state is NOT re-emitted, however many advances it survives
every real transition is one emission
returning to a previous state emits again
a blank state name is not a state

events.name: a plain rive event carries its name and no properties
properties keep booleans, finite numbers and strings, in sorted order
a nested object property is DROPPED and counted, never flattened
an openUrl rive event is delivered as DATA; nothing navigates
an unnamed rive event is dropped entirely

load.name: a machine load reports the machine and the intrinsic size
an animation load reports the animation and a null machine

payload.message: the artboard, state machine or animation this <rive> names is not in the file
this .riv file could not be decoded
the .riv file could not be loaded
this platform ships no Rive runtime

errors.name: an unknown code keeps the code and takes the generic message

payload.message: the .riv file could not be loaded
